7: Beresheet. Rabbi Yudai asks, What is Beresheet? It means 'with wisdom'. And this is the wisdom upon which the world is established and allowed to enter the deep and secretive mysteries. Here the six supernal directions [the cardinal directions and up and down] are engraved, from which everything emerges. From them were formed the six sources and rivers, [Zeir Anpin] that flow into the great sea, [Malkuth]. Bara Sheet ["He created six"] were created from here. [Beresheet contains six letters as well.] And who created them? He who is not mentioned; He who is concealed and unknown. [Arich Anpin]
